plotSections.title: Signaling before the Sunder stop
bullets: The dragon-rider guild has flags, but they are for ground observers to signal riders, not for riders to carry.
Walker usually relies on mind messages from Dana instead of traditional signaling.
Elrus and Plymouth teach Walker rudimentary SOS fire signals and basic flag-communique recognition, but not as a proficiency.
Elrus and Araden fly to the mountains while Walker and Plymouth enter Sunder.

plotSections.title: Arrival in Sunder
bullets: Sunder is a floating city of towers and islands with districts including Haven Hold, the Bronze Palace, the Bronze Arena, Miss Mary’s, the docks, the Prancing Fox, and Louise Casino.
The Haven may have exhaustion potions and magic items obtainable through investigative work and another Sunder Chase circuit.
Haven Hold’s dragon hoard is enchanted by Benji and that dragon as a pre-race prize pick.
Calypso runs a floating vending operation between Miss Mary’s and the dock corridor.
The docks are busy with griffins, giant eagles, flying ships, and a diverse market crowd; Walker draws fewer stares than usual for a dragon rider.
Glimmen waits outside shops while Walker goes inside.

plotSections.title: Shopping goals
bullets: Walker seeks potions or magic items to offset daily dragon-rider exhaustion.
Plymouth seeks horn root, powdered dragon scale, wet alchemical items, and dragon gizzard for spell components.
Plymouth recommends greater restoration or a rare potion of vitality, though both are expensive in Sunder.
They buy herbs and raw ingredients from street vendors, then enter an apothecary.

plotSections.title: Qualin's Quax
bullets: The apothecary is doubly named Qualin's Quax and smells of thyme, oleander, earthy root, and citrus.
The shopkeeper is a duck-like Aarakocra in a blue robe with purple trim, scarred and stately, cataloging potions when they enter.
Plymouth asks for dragon gizzard; the shopkeeper says stock is low and it is sold by the pound.
Walker fails a perception check with disadvantage from exhaustion, getting distracted by the shop and by the shopkeeper’s purple gem necklace.
Plymouth negotiates dragon gizzard at five gold per pound while Walker misses part of the exchange.
The shopkeeper’s family-heirloom gem is called the Quackless of the Quinn’s line and would take about five million gold to part with.
Walker asks for exhaustion relief; the shopkeeper produces a milk-crate holder built for five small vials with one slot empty and four remaining potions that resemble greater healing vials.

chronologicalEvents: Walker learns guild flags are for others to signal dragon riders, not for riders to use outbound.
Elrus and Plymouth teach Walker basic SOS fire signals and simple flag recognition.
Elrus and Araden fly to the mountains; Walker and Plymouth land in Sunder.
The DM describes Sunder’s districts, the Haven Hold hoard prize, and Calypso’s vending route.
Walker and Plymouth discuss their separate shopping goals for exhaustion relief and alchemical supplies.
They purchase herbs and ingredients from street vendors.
Plymouth leads Walker into the apothecary Qualin's Quax.
A duck-like Aarakocra shopkeeper greets them and says dragon gizzard is sold by the pound.
Walker rolls perception with disadvantage and becomes distracted by the shop and the shopkeeper’s gem.
Plymouth secures dragon gizzard at five gold per pound while Walker misses details of the exchange.
Walker learns the shopkeeper’s heirloom gem the Quackless of the Quinn’s line is worth about five million gold and not for sale.
Walker asks for help with exhaustion.
The shopkeeper brings out a crate of five vial slots with one missing and four exhaustion potions remaining.

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider and fighter bonded to Glimmen, Gatekeeper of The Reach.
notes: Is shopping in Sunder with Plymouth for exhaustion relief while suffering one level of exhaustion.
Fails a perception check with disadvantage because of exhaustion and fixation on the shopkeeper’s gem.
Asks the apothecary for something to help with constant exhaustion.
Usually communicates while flying via mind messages from Dana rather than flags or fire signals.
personality: Easily distracted by valuable gems and curios.
quotesThemes: I suffer from exhaustion all the time.

Plymouth Gawater.existing: Gnome artificer and party ally who guides the new keepers.
notes: Leads Walker through Sunder’s market to Qualin's Quax.
Seeks horn root, powdered dragon scale, wet alchemical items, and dragon gizzard.
Negotiates dragon gizzard at five gold per pound while Walker is distracted.
Makes a knowing hum during the shopkeeper’s appraisal of the pair.
Duck-like Aarakocra proprietor of Qualin's Quax in Sunder.
Wears a stately blue robe with purple trim and a floppy circular hat.
Has burn scars, notches, and pockmarks on his large bill.
Wears a precious purple gem necklace that is a family heirloom.
Is low on dragon gizzard and sells it by the pound.
Has a crate of five small exhaustion potion vials with one already sold and four remaining.
personality: Dutiful, professor-like, and shrewd in appraising customers.
quotesThemes: What brings you to my shop?

notes: Purple heirloom gem worn by Qualin of the Quinn’s line.
Not for sale; Qualin says it would take about five million gold to part with it.
Walker estimates it as high-tier or mid-tier, comparable to star gems and other valuable couturements he carries.
Small apothecary shop in Sunder with a doubly punned name.
Smells of thyme, oleander, earthy root, and citrus.
Sells dragon gizzard by the pound and carries exhaustion potions resembling greater healing vials.
Floating Reach city where Walker and Plymouth are shopping.
Contains Haven Hold, the Bronze Palace, the Bronze Arena, Miss Mary’s, the docks, the Prancing Fox, and Louise Casino.
Follows Walker through Sunder and waits outside while he enters shops.

Elrus.existing: Walker's hidden ally in the coming confrontation.
notes: Helps teach Walker fire signals, then flies with Araden to the mountains to rendezvous later.

Araden.existing: A magically capable companion brought secretly to The Reach.
notes: Flies with Elrus to the mountains while Walker and Plymouth shop in Sunder.
Usually sends Walker short mind messages while he is flying instead of using traditional dragon-rider signaling.
